description: Core USB host management implementation for Zephyr OS, including event handling, thread management, and device initialization.

methods.name: usbh_event_carrier
methods.description: Handles USB host controller events by placing them into a message queue.

methods.name: discard_ep_request
methods.description: Discards an endpoint request, freeing associated buffers.

methods.name: usbh_event_handler
methods.description: Processes different types of USB host controller events, including device connection, removal, reset, suspend, resume, and errors.

methods.name: usbh_thread
methods.description: Main thread loop that processes events from the message queue and dispatches them to appropriate handlers.

methods.name: usbh_init_device_intl
methods.description: Initializes a USB device context and sets up class drivers (placeholder).

methods.name: uhs_pre_init
methods.description: Pre-initialization function that creates the USB host thread and sets its name.
